items.html: *Know that AVI Ilain were made as follows: Aba, from the female, is the upper half of Bina of Mah; and Ima, from the male, is the entirety of Chochma of Ban. But this Chochma of Ban is called Ima, since it is the aspect of Ban; and the Bina of Mah is called Chochma, since it is of Mah. Understand this. It follows, then, that in truth both of them are called Chochma alone, and they are the aspect of the first Yod of the Name.
